name: Festivus
description: Open-source Physical AI platform. Curated dataset of robots, policies, environments, datasets, and benchmarks served over a public HTTP API.

read.scope: all public web pages and the data API at https://api.festivus.hapticlabs.ai
read.notes: Robots.txt grants explicit Allow to ClaudeBot, GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Amazonbot, cohere-ai, and others. See /robots.txt.

write.auth: issued X-API-Key with tier=write; not self-serve
write.notes: Dataset contributions go through the human-curated /contribute flow on the web app, not direct API writes.

training.scope: All public content under the Apache 2.0 license. Provenance attribution required where the upstream dataset requires it; see data/PROVENANCE.md.
training.notes: We want the dataset to be useful to LLMs and AI coding agents. No opt-out for training on public content.

edgeMitigation.guidance: Do not retry; back off. Aggressive retry triggers further mitigation.
